prompt:
A battle background for a side-on JRPG battle scene (the party will stand on the right, monsters on the left; no characters are drawn), in rich high-resolution 2D pixel art. The world is in an endless night: the sun has vanished and people live by lamplight. Setting: moonlit desert dunes. Back (top 42%): huge starry sky with a big pale moon, rolling dunes into the distance, half-buried ancient sandstone ruins and an obelisk silhouette, faint violet horizon glow. Ground (lower 58%): cool rippled sand with scattered stones, dry grass tufts and a broken column at the sides. Light: cold blue moonlight, long soft shadows. The ground plane recedes from the bottom edge up to the horizon line at a low 3/4 angle; the middle of the ground (from 55% to 90% of the height, centre and right) is open, fairly flat and uncluttered: space for the battle. Details (rocks, plants, debris) sit at the sides and far away. 
No lantern, no fire in the middle, no people, no monsters, no text, no UI.
Pixel art: every art pixel is 4x4 image pixels (the image is 960 x 540 art pixels), crisp square pixels, no anti-aliasing, hue-shifted colour ramps (shadows toward violet, lights toward warm yellow), clusters with clear shapes, not a painting.
revised_prompt: Generate a single finished, high-resolution 2D pixel-art BACKGROUND ONLY for a side-on JRPG combat scene, widescreen 16:9 composition. Party placement will be on right and enemies on left, but draw NO characters. Pixel-art aesthetic must be genuinely hard-edged square-pixel clusters: visible, consistent 4x4 output-pixel art pixels, crisp nearest-neighbor edges, zero antialiasing, zero smooth painting/brush textures, no gradients except stepped pixel dithering, coherent hue-shifted color ramps (violet shadows, pale warm-yellow highlights). A world in endless night after the sun vanished. Moonlit desert dunes. Upper ~42%: expansive navy starry sky, big pale moon, rolling dunes shrinking into distance, ancient half-buried sandstone ruins and distant obelisk silhouette, faint violet horizon glow. Lower ~58%: low three-quarter-angle receding ground plane from bottom edge toward horizon, cool moonlit rippled sand, long soft-looking shadows constructed from crisp pixel clusters. Stones, sparse dry grass and one broken column ONLY at outer sides / far distance. Important middle ground from image height 55% to 90%, center AND right: open fairly flat, un cluttered playable battle area. Strong restrained composition, deep blues, muted violets, moonlight, desert atmosphere. NO lanterns, NO fire, NO people, NO monsters, NO text, NO user interface, NO graphic border. Wide full-bleed game environment backdrop.
